test_vectors.name: TV1 apparel default, unprofitable on order one
TV2 zero return rate, healthy order
test_vectors.worked: revenue 100, cogs 100*0.3*1=30, shipping 5, handling 0, processing 2.9+0.30=3.20. contribution 100-30-5-0-3.2=61.80. profit 41.80. break-even ceil(20/61.8)=1. safe_threshold 5.00, 41.80 > 5 -> SAFE TO SCALE. Range: return flex inert at 0, so CAC only. HIGH cac 16 -> 45.80. LOW cac 24 -> 37.80.

test_vectors.name: TV3 nothing resellable, repeat toggle on
test_vectors.worked: revenue 0.7*50=35. cogs 50*0.4*(1-0.3*0)=20. shipping 6. handling 0.3*10=3. processing 0.03*50+0.30=1.80. contribution 35-20-6-3-1.8=4.20. profit 4.20-15=-10.80. drag 0.3*(50*(1-0)+10)=18.00 (check: zero-return contribution 50*0.6-6-1.8=22.20; 22.20-4.20=18.00). break-even ceil(15/4.2)=ceil(3.5714)=4. repeat 1/(1-0.4)=1.6667 orders; 1.6667*4.2-15=7.00-15=-8.00, still negative -> NOT YET. HIGH r=0.24 cac=12: 0.76*50=38, cogs 20, handling 2.4, proc 1.8, contribution 7.80, profit -4.20. LOW r=0.36 cac=18: 0.64*50=32, cogs 20, handling 3.6, proc 1.8, contribution 0.60, profit -17.40.

test_vectors.name: TV1 apparel default
TV2 zero returns, high margin
test_vectors.worked: contribution 120*0.6=72. cm_net 0.6. BE 1/0.6=1.666667 -> 1.67, identical to naive, penalty 0.00. target 1/(0.6-0.15)=2.222222 -> 2.22. max CAC 72.00, for target 72-18=54.00. at 4x 0.60-0.25=0.35 -> 35.0%. Range collapses at r=0.

test_vectors.name: TV3 thin margin, returns break the model
test_vectors.worked: contribution 0.65*40*0.25-0.35*14=6.5-4.9=1.60. cm_net 1.6/40=0.04. BE 1/0.04=25.00. naive 1/0.25=4.00. penalty 21.00. target null since cm_net 0.04 < t 0.10. max CAC 1.60; for target 1.6-4=-2.40 -> displays 'not reachable'. at 4x 0.04-0.25=-0.21 -> -21.0%, and since the reported ROAS is 4.0 the same -21.0% is what the platform's number is really buying. best r=0.28: contribution 0.72*10-3.92=7.2-3.92=3.28, cm_net 0.082, BE 1/0.082=12.195122 -> 12.20. worst r=0.42: contribution 0.58*10-5.88=5.8-5.88=-0.08, negative -> null.

test_vectors.name: TV1 apparel default, CAC on, discounting off
TV2 zero returns, discounting ON, CAC omitted
TV3 fractional lifespan, mostly exchanges
test_vectors.worked: net_aov 80*(1-0.4*0.25)=80*0.9=72.00. A 40% return rate that is three quarters exchanges only costs 10% of revenue. orders 1.5*2.5=3.75. contribution per order 72*0.52=37.44; LTV 37.44*3.75=140.40. naive 80*0.52*3.75=156.00, gap 15.60. after CAC 95.40. ratio 140.40/45=3.12. Fractional-year path check with dr=0: C_yr=37.44*1.5=56.16; floor(y)=2 so 56.16+56.16 plus 0.5*56.16=28.08 gives 140.40, matching. LOW f=1.2: orders 3.0 -> 37.44*3=112.32. HIGH f=1.8: orders 4.5 -> 37.44*4.5=168.48.

TV2 refund total blank, derived from return rate and exchanges, both inputs flexed
